verdict.rationale: Box's API is built on OAuth 2.0 tokens (box-docs-1, box-docs-17) and the hosted MCP server explicitly gates agent access to files via OAuth rather than raw credentials (box-docs-11, box-docs-23, box-docs-29), and collaborations/roles let admins define per-user/group access levels (box-docs-4, box-docs-21, box-docs-37) which could underlie least-privilege agent access. However, there is no explicit documentation in this pack of a dedicated 'scoped/downscoped token' or service-account API purpose-built for issuing least-privilege credentials to an individual agent. Missing for 10: explicit token-downscoping/service-account API docs, granular scope-selection UI for agent credentials, and independent confirmation that agent tokens can be scoped narrower than full user OAuth grants.
